title: Reaper (MQ-9) Sensor Operator (MGySgt to Pvt) NMOS (7314), DC AVN
raw_text:
12.     MOS 8022, Reaper (MQ-9) Sensor Operator (MGySgt to Pvt) NMOS (7314), DC
AVN

    a. Summary. Reaper Specialists perform specific support functions
directly related to MQ-9 operations. This MOS will be assigned as an NMOS
only.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Must be skill qualified as an UAS Operator (MOS 7314).

        (2) Must meet all the physical requirements per reference (ai), the
Naval Medical Department Manual, section IV, article 15-100.

        (3) Security requirement: top secret security clearance with
eligibility for sensitive compartmented information (TS/SCI).

    c. Requirements. This MOS is to be assigned as NMOS to qualified
Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) Operator (MOS 7314) who have successfully
completed the formal training at the USAF Remotely Piloted Aircraft (RPA)
Course (F16H3Q4) Basic Sensor Operator (BSOC) School, Randolph AFB, TX; and
the USAF MQ-9 Enlisted Course (F34RPD1) Initial Qualification Training (IQT)
School, Holloman AFB, NM.

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to the Air
Force MQ-9 Sensor Operator Training and Readiness Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Electro-Mechanical Technicians 17-3024.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.
